description: List/filter companies. Supports cursor pagination and structured filters. Folk REST: GET /v1/companies.

combinator.description: How to combine multiple filters — 'and' (all must match) or 'or' (any). Default 'and'.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — pass the value from a previous page's pagination.nextLink to fetch the next page.

filter.description: Structured filter: attribute → operator → value, expanded to filter[attribute][operator]=value query keys. Example: {"firstName":{"eq":"John"}}.

name: folk_list_companies
title: List companies
